summary: Frontend-only static marketing site for QuincyFadez tested end-to-end via Playwright on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 8 features from the review request PASS. No console errors, no page errors, no broken images, no horizontal overflow.

detailed_results.hero_heading: PASS — h1 renders 'The best / barber in / Oxford.'
detailed_results.nav_anchors: PASS — nav-about, nav-work, nav-services, nav-visit all scroll to correct sections (scrollY progressed 1214 -> 2166 -> 6160 -> 7187)
detailed_results.book_ctas: PASS — header-book-btn, hero-book-btn, membership-join-btn, footer-book-btn, service-0..3 all href=https://www.barbr.me/quincyfadez, target=_blank
detailed_results.instagram_links: PASS — gallery-instagram-link and footer-instagram-btn both -> https://www.instagram.com/QuincyFadez
detailed_results.gallery_images: PASS — 6/6 images loaded from b-cdn.net (naturalWidth=2160 each), 0 broken
detailed_results.services_and_prices: PASS — Hair Cut £20, Haircut & Beard £25, Shape Up £10, Beard Trim £10, VIP x4 £64 all present
detailed_results.hours_all_days: PASS — Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat/Sun all rendered; current day (Thursday during test) shows 'TODAY' pill with emerald pulse dot
detailed_results.responsive_mobile: PASS — 390px viewport: scrollWidth=390, innerWidth=390, no horizontal overflow. Screenshot confirms header, hero, book CTA all stack correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: footer-whatsapp-btn is labeled 'Message' with MessageCircle icon but its href points to Instagram (LINKS.instagram), not WhatsApp. The review says 'contact via WhatsApp/Instagram' — if a real WhatsApp URL is intended, add LINKS.whatsapp (e.g., https://wa.me/<number>) and wire it to footer-whatsapp-btn. Currently both Instagram + Message buttons open the same URL.
Minor: EditorialMarquee and AboutManifesto components were not part of the reviewer's explicit testid list but render correctly (no errors).
Nice-to-have: hero lacks explicit width/height causing minor CLS; consider adding decoding='async' and width/height attributes.
Good practices observed: all external links use rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'; data-testid coverage is thorough; env var REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preserved even though unused (static site).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static single-page site. All CTAs are external links (barbr.me for booking, instagram.com for social). No backend/API calls. footer-whatsapp-btn currently reuses Instagram URL — flagged as minor code review comment, not a blocker.
